name: IPAM Lite
description: Full IP address space management for Kea-managed AND unmanaged subnets, using everything Jen already knows: gateway, DNS and pool awareness (an address inside a DHCP pool is marked; infrastructure addresses are labelled, never "available"), a one-click next free address outside the pools, the devices table beside each lease, conflicts when a static address is taken by a DHCP client, per-address history, range operations, and Netbox/CSV import and export with a review step. Replaces Netbox for simple static IP tracking.
author: Matthew Thibodeau

db_migrations.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ipam_static_entries (id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, ip VARCHAR(15) NOT NULL, subnet_id INT NOT NULL, label VARCHAR(100), owner VARCHAR(100), notes TEXT, created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ipam_assignment_history (id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, ip VARCHAR(15) NOT NULL, subnet_id INT NOT NULL, label VARCHAR(100), owner VARCHAR(100), action VARCHAR(20), acted_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, acted_by VARCHAR(100))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ipam_subnets (id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, cidr VARCHAR(18) NOT NULL, description TEXT, created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
ALTER TABLE ipam_static_entries ADD COLUMN subnet_kind ENUM('kea','ipam') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'kea' AFTER ip

db_migrations.description: entries: manual hostname for unmanaged subnets
db_migrations.sql: ALTER TABLE ipam_static_entries ADD COLUMN hostname VARCHAR(255) NULL AFTER notes

db_migrations.description: entries: manual MAC for unmanaged subnets
db_migrations.sql: ALTER TABLE ipam_static_entries ADD COLUMN mac VARCHAR(17) NULL AFTER hostname
ALTER TABLE ipam_static_entries ADD COLUMN is_static TINYINT(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 AFTER mac

db_migrations.description: entries: drop the v1.1.0 UNIQUE(ip) — an IP can now exist per subnet kind
db_migrations.sql: ALTER TABLE ipam_static_entries DROP INDEX ip
ALTER TABLE ipam_static_entries ADD UNIQUE KEY uniq_ip_kind_subnet (ip, subnet_kind, subnet_id)
ALTER TABLE ipam_static_entries ADD INDEX idx_kind_subnet (subnet_kind, subnet_id)
ALTER TABLE ipam_assignment_history ADD COLUMN subnet_kind ENUM('kea','ipam') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'kea' AFTER ip
ALTER TABLE ipam_static_entries ADD COLUMN entry_status VARCHAR(20) NULL AFTER is_static
UPDATE ipam_static_entries SET entry_status = CASE WHEN is_static=1 THEN 'static' ELSE 'available' END WHERE entry_status IS NULL

db_migrations.description: history: index (subnet_kind, subnet_id, acted_at) for the per-address and recent-changes views (v1.5.0)
db_migrations.sql: ALTER TABLE ipam_assignment_history ADD INDEX idx_hist_kind_subnet_at (subnet_kind, subnet_id, acted_at)

db_migrations.description: unmanaged subnets: optional gateway, shown as infrastructure (v1.5.0)
db_migrations.sql: ALTER TABLE ipam_subnets ADD COLUMN gateway VARCHAR(15) NULL AFTER description
